correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation yields pointwise trace(J)=det(J)=tr(J²)=0 and hence nilpotence. On a periodic orbit, z_i=Ax_i², so h_{i+1}=A(x_i-x_{i+1})² and x_{i+1}=P(h_i). For three indices this says the heights are precisely A times the three pairwise squared differences of real q_i=P(h_i). Distinct heights exclude zero and real line triangle distances satisfy max=sum of other two after square roots. Conversely interpolation q(r²)=0,q(s²)=(r+s)/sqrt A,q((r+s)²)=s/sqrt A gives a genuine degree-2 polynomial and both opposite cyclic height orders; coordinate reconstruction is exact. Direct substitution verifies the two rational example cycles and the reversal is not a rotation.
